snippet.title: GREX - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Grex announcement trailer for this swarm-based roguelite auto-shooter where you don’t play a hero - you play hundreds. All Grexlings move, fight, sacrifice, and obliterate as one hive mind. GREX is fast, chaotic, and occasionally breaks into full overpower. On purpose. GREX will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
